DOCUMENTATION-DERIVED fixtures, NOT captured output.

None of iTerm2, Kitty, WezTerm, Alacritty or tmux was installed on the Mac
these were written on. Each file follows the tool's documented output shape,
with sanitized values (home /Users/example, uid 501):

- kitty-ls.json: `kitty @ --to unix:<sock> ls` (Kitty remote-control docs,
  "ls" command: OS windows -> tabs -> windows with id, pid, cwd, is_focused,
  foreground_processes, ...).
- kitty-error-*.txt: stderr of a failed `kitty @` (Kitty source messages).
- wezterm-list.json: `wezterm cli list --format json` (WezTerm CLI docs:
  window_id, tab_id, pane_id, workspace, size, title, cwd, cursor_*,
  is_active, is_zoomed, tty_name).
- wezterm-list-clients.json: `wezterm cli list-clients --format json`
  (username, hostname, pid, connection_elapsed, idle_time, workspace,
  focused_pane_id).
- tmux-*.txt: tmux FORMATS output for the exact -F strings in
  src/common/tmux.rs (tab separated), and tmux's own error texts.

Verify on a real machine by capturing the same commands and diffing shapes.
